add.title: Add account
add.headline: Add your mail account
add.intro: mailbowox connects straight to your provider over IMAP and SMTP. Your password stays on your devices, and leaves them only encrypted, if you turn on sync or notifications.
add.name: Your name
add.footer: Any provider with IMAP and SMTP works. Gmail and Outlook are not supported yet.
add.otherDevice: Already use mailbowox on another device? Bring your accounts over without typing a password.
add.lookingUp: Looking up the server settings for {{domain}}. This can take a few seconds.

needs.email: Enter your email address to continue.
needs.fullEmail: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.
needs.imapPort: Enter the incoming mail port, a number from 1 to 65535.
needs.smtpPort: Enter the outgoing mail port, a number from 1 to 65535.
needs.davUrl: Fix the contacts server address under Advanced.

errors.auth: The server rejected this username or password. Some providers need an app password.
errors.discovery: Couldn't look up the settings for this address. Enter them below.

relay.headline: Connect through a relay
relay.intro: A browser can't open mail connections itself, so mailbowox passes them through a relay, which forwards the encrypted connection without being able to read it.

found.provider: Settings from mailbowox's list of providers
found.srv: Settings published in your domain's DNS
found.mx: Settings of the provider that receives your domain's mail
found.probe: Found by trying common server names

servers.notFound: No settings found for {{domain}}. Your provider's help pages list them.
servers.probeNote: These servers answered, but nothing from your provider confirms them. Sign in only if they look right.
servers.securityHint: TLS and STARTTLS both encrypt the connection: pick the one your provider lists. TLS usually runs on ports 993 and 465, STARTTLS on 143 and 587.
servers.securityPlainHint: None sends everything unencrypted, for a local test server only.
servers.davUrlInvalid: Enter the full address, starting with https://.
servers.carddavHint: Leave empty to find the contacts server from your email address.

failed.incoming: Incoming mail didn't work with {{host}} on port {{port}}.
failed.outgoing: Incoming mail works, but outgoing mail didn't work with {{host}} on port {{port}}.
failed.contacts: Mail works, but the contacts server at {{url}} didn't answer as expected. Fix its address under Advanced, or clear it.

errors.missingPassword: The password for {{email}} is missing on this device. Remove the account and add it again.
